title: Discover Peru
short_description: Cusco - Sacred Valley - Ollantaytambo - Machu Picchu - Rainbow Mountain - Humantay Lake.
long_description: Explore the best of Peru in 8 days: from Lima to Cusco, discover history, culture, and iconic landscapes such as Machu Picchu, Humantay Lake, and Rainbow Mountain.
price_note: Includes transportation, entrance tickets, and professional guide.

days.title: Day 1: Arrival in Lima
days.text: Reception at the airport and transfer to the hotel. Check-in from 2:00 PM. Optional city tour if you arrive in the morning.

days.title: Day 2: Paracas - Ballestas Islands - Ica - Huacachina
days.text: Early departure to Paracas to visit the Ballestas Islands. Continue to Ica for a vineyard tour and wine tasting. In the afternoon, enjoy an adventure in Huacachina with dune buggies and sandboarding. Return to Lima.

days.title: Day 3: Flight Lima - Cusco
days.text: Transfer to the airport and flight to Cusco. Reception and transfer to the hotel. Free afternoon to acclimatize or visit the Qosqo Native Art Center.

days.title: Day 4: Sacred Valley of the Incas Tour from Cusco
days.text: Enjoy a complete experience exploring the Sacred Valley of the Incas, one of the most important and spectacular routes in Cusco. This full-day tour combines ancient history, living Andean culture, and unique natural landscapes, visiting some of the most emblematic Inca archaeological sites in Peru. During the tour, you will visit traditional villages, Inca agricultural terraces, and scenic viewpoints that showcase the greatness of the ancient Inca Empire. The Sacred Valley is an essential stop before Machu Picchu and a must-do experience to understand Cusco’s history and culture in one day.

days.title: Day 5: Machu Picchu Tour - World Wonder from Cusco
days.text: Enjoy a full-day tour to Machu Picchu, one of the Seven Wonders of the Modern World and the most iconic archaeological site in Peru. The experience begins with an early departure from Cusco by tourist train to Aguas Calientes. From there, you will ascend by shuttle bus to the Inca citadel, where you will enjoy a guided tour of the main archaeological sectors, learning about the history, architecture, and legacy of the Inca civilization. Free time for photos and personal exploration before returning to Cusco in the afternoon. This Machu Picchu tour is the highlight of the trip and an unforgettable experience in the Andes of Cusco.

days.title: Day 6: Rainbow Mountain (Vinicunca)
days.text: Full-day tour to Rainbow Mountain (Vinicunca), one of the most visited natural attractions in Cusco. Early departure by tourist transportation to Cusipata, followed by a moderate hike to the summit located at 5,036 meters (16,522 ft) above sea level. During the hike, enjoy panoramic views of the Ausangate glacier and the mountain’s impressive natural colors. Accompanied by a professional guide. Return to Cusco in the afternoon.

days.title: Day 7: Humantay Lake
days.text: Full-day tour to Humantay Lake, one of the most impressive natural landscapes in Cusco. Early departure by tourist transportation to Mollepata, followed by a moderate hike to the lake located at 4,200 meters (13,780 ft) above sea level. Accompanied by a professional guide, enjoy panoramic views of Andean glaciers and the lake’s intense turquoise color. Return to Cusco in the afternoon.

days.title: Day 8: Departure
days.text: Transfer to the airport according to your flight schedule. End of services.
